verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents in-platform user access reviews. User data is pulled automatically from native and custom integrations or by CSV, and reviewers are designated per system on recurring schedules with reminders. Reviewers decide in-app to maintain, modify, revoke or mark access out of scope, and follow-up tasks are created and synced to ticketing tools. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the completed review is stored as an artifact in the evidence library, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
